id./param/scenario/cs/b_150_cs_050.pack|cs_: "...You all saw that scene, didn't you?
"There was a man with a mark on his left hand like {var:1}'s. Could he be...?
"{var:1}, you must know. That man must be our ancestor... the legendary Luminary Erdwin.
"To see his valiant form like this...
"That was the former Luminary and his companions who defeated the Dark One...
"Then we may learn how the former Luminary fought the Dark One, especially the power that dispels darkness.
"Yes, worth trying. {var:1}, shall we examine the other saplings?"
